method: Independent source/AST review, original atomscan scans and cleave facts; controlled before/after atomscan scans use SCAN_FOLLOW=none and a git HEAD rules snapshot. No sample execution. Both carrier payload strings equal the standalone AppleScript after stripping outer whitespace. No encoding or obfuscation layers are present.
execution: Node execFileSync and Python subprocess.run hand the raw payload to /usr/bin/osascript -e at module load. The standalone file requires an AppleScript host.
verdict_evidence: System Preferences impersonation with masked password input and dscl validation; Safe Storage password query and local plaintext staging; Keychain DB, AWS and SSH copies into one tmp directory; ditto ZIP and curl PUT of that directory archive. Conditional Trezor bundle probing, authenticated ZIP fetch/extraction, app.asar and Info.plist replacement, forced ad-hoc signing and recursive xattr clearing.
limits: The prompted password is validated, not explicitly saved or sent. Runtime success is unknown: cancellation, permissions, missing directories, Keychain access and network failure can abort execution. Trezor substitution requires the application to exist. The downloaded wallet payload is not supplied, so its internals and subsequent execution are unknown. No persistence, privilege escalation or cleanup is present in these bytes. Registry provenance/version and actual deployment authorization are not supplied; family naming is descriptive and uncorroborated.

rule_corrections.neutral_signing: All matcher predicates, scope and 1200-byte proximity preserved. Copying and forced ad-hoc signing alone establish no process masquerading. The maintenance control matches the old suspicious finding and the new notable capability; the hostile detection never fires there.
rule_corrections.hostile_substitution: All matcher predicates and severity preserved. Move from process masquerading to trusted wallet application substitution; revise ATT&CK mapping accordingly. No exact or ancestor selectors consumed the old wallet rules outside their own file.
rule_corrections.put: Add method-specific command evidence. Restrict preceding flags to argument-free clusters, require the complete PUT token, and reject PUT text in data and -d -X PUT.

consumer_audit: Crypto ancestor selectors have needs:1, or PE/PowerShell scopes ineligible for the macOS script composite. No proximity/count consumer gains a matching population; codesign was already under crypto. No consumers select the destination supply-chain ancestors or HTTP PUT directory.
controls: 11 static controls passed. Renamed Ledger/different staging/host positive retains both wallet observations and all five hostile behaviors. Maintenance, signing-only, POST, PUT in quoted request data, data-option consumption and method-prefix negatives pass. Outside fixtures cap-native-deps-setup.js, tradertraitor-safari-updater.sh and sign-only-installer.sh retain every original finding and severity; the hostile updater retains 3H/2S.
initial_scan_difference: The initial default-follow scan emitted an extra derived suspicious applescript-password-phishing aggregate for the standalone AppleScript (5H/10S). Comparable byte-only baseline is 5H/9S. The other initial H/S counts agree with the controlled baseline. Default-follow reports also serialize additional derived neutral aggregates. Controlled final comparison loses only the two explicitly relocated IDs.
classifier: All samples remain on the calibrated classifier alert grid: JavaScript level 1750, Python and AppleScript level 0. Probabilities remain high. No new classifier miss is exposed. The installed model uses feature spec 18 while engine expects 21; JavaScript retains a flow-query-incomplete analysis gap. Static review establishes the payload independently.
